narrative.overview: BatchHub is designed as a calm, dark-adapted academic workspace built for deep concentration, night-owl study cycles, and high-signal cohort collaboration. The interface treats screen real estate like a precision instrument: dark oceanic obsidian surfaces recede into the background, allowing vital deadlines, urgent announcements, and peer project activity to emerge as luminous mint and emerald beacons.
keyCharacteristics: Nocturnal Tonal Depth: Multi-tiered slate-obsidian backgrounds (#0B1418, #0E181C, #111D22) create spatial hierarchy without heavy shadows.
Selective Luminous Accents: Vivid mint (#2EE59D) is reserved strictly for high-value interactive anchors, active routes, and primary actions.
Refined Pill-Form Geometry: Gentle 12px pill curves and 16px container radiuses impart tactile softness while preserving academic seriousness.
Anti-References: Cluttered multi-color student templates, flashy gamer neon, and bureaucratic institutional LMS tables.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Vivid Mint (#2EE59D) must cover <= 10% of any viewport. Its power comes from restraint; when everything glows, nothing is urgent.

rules.name: The No-White-Surface Rule
rules.body: Pure white (#FFFFFF) is strictly for typography and icons; it is never used as a background container color.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: All deadlines, countdowns, timestamps, and metric counts must render with consistent character widths to avoid layout jitter.

rules.name: The Glow-Over-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Never use diffuse colored drop shadows under cards. Convey focus and selection with a 1px border stroke tint rather than fuzzy outer glows.

dos: Do use tonal surface step-ups (#0B1418 -> #0E181C -> #111D22 -> #15242B) to express hierarchy.
Do reserve #2EE59D for primary calls-to-action, active indicators, and critical badges.
Do use 1px subtle borders (#1A2F37) to separate adjacent dark sections cleanly.
Do provide instant feedback via toast messages or inline state transitions rather than native browser alert().
Do maintain a consistent 12px pill radius on interactive inputs and buttons.
donts: Don't use multi-color neon gradients or rainbow accents across cards.
Don't use pure black (#000000) or pure white (#FFFFFF) for background container surfaces.
Don't allow primary mint accents to exceed 10% of the visible viewport area.
Don't use heavy colored drop shadows under resting cards.
Don't display raw database timestamps without humanized formatting (e.g., 'Oct 24, 2026').
